an7.50:1.1: Atha kho Jānussoṇī brāhmaṇo yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavatā saddhiṃ . . .
an7.50:1.3: ‘bhavam pi no Gotamo brahmacārī paṭijānātī' ti. ‘Yaṃ
an7.50:1.4: hi taṃ brāhmaṇa sammā vadamāno vadeyya
an7.50:1.5: "akhaṇḍaṃ acchiddaṃ asabalaṃ akammāsaṃ paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ caratī" ti; mam' eva taṃ brāhmaṇa sammā vadamāno vadeyya,
an7.50:1.6: ahaṃ hi brāhmaṇa akhaṇḍaṃ acchiddaṃ asabalaṃ akammāsaṃ paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carāmī' ti.
an7.50:1.7: ‘Kiṃ pana bho Gotama brahmacariyassa khaṇḍam pi chiddam pi sabalam pi kammāsam pī' ti? 2.
an7.50:2.1: Idha brāhmaṇa ekacco samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā sammābrahmacārī paṭijānamāno na h' eva kho mātugāmena saddhiṃ dvayandvayasamāpattiṃ samāpajjati,
an7.50:2.2: api ca kho mātugāmassa ucchādanaparimaddananahāpanasambāhanaṃ sādiyati.
an7.50:2.3: So taṃ assādeti taṃ nikāmeti tena ca vittiṃ āpajjati.
an7.50:2.4: Idam pi kho brāhmaṇa brahmacariyassa khaṇḍam pi chiddam pi sabalam pi kammāsam pi.
an7.50:2.5: Ayaṃ vuccati brāhmaṇa aparisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carati saṃyutto methunena saṃyogena, na parimuccati jātiyā jarāmaraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi, na parimuccati dukkhasmā ti vadāmi. 3.
an7.50:3.1: Puna ca paraṃ brāhmaṇa idh' ekacco samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā sammābrahmacārī paṭijānamāno na h' eva kho mātugāmena saddhiṃ dvayandvayasamāpattiṃ samāpajjati, na pi mātugāmassa ucchādanaparimaddananahāpanasambāhanaṃ sādiyati,
an7.50:3.2: api ca kho mātugāmena saddhiṃ sañjagghati saṃkīḷati saṃkeḷāyati . . . pe . . .
an7.50:4.1: na pi mātugāmena saddhiṃ sañjagghati saṃkīḷati saṃkeḷāyati,
an7.50:4.2: api ca kho mātugāmassa cakkhunā cakkhuṃ upanijjhāyati pekkhati . . .
an7.50:5.1: na pi mātugāmassa cakkhunā cakkhuṃ upanijjhāyati pekkhati,
an7.50:5.2: api ca kho mātugāmassa saddaṃ suṇāti tirokuḍḍaṃ vā tiropākāraṃ vā hasantiyā vā bhaṇantiyā vā gāyantiyā vā rodantiyā vā . . .
an7.50:6.1: na pi mātugāmassa saddaṃ suṇāti tirokuḍḍaṃ vā tiropākāraṃ vā hasantiyā vā bhaṇantiyā vā gāyantiyā vā rodantiyā vā,
an7.50:6.2: api ca kho yāni 'ssa tāni pubbe mātugāmena saddhiṃ hasitalapitakīḷitāni anussarati . . .
an7.50:7.1: na pi yāni' ssa tāni pubbe mātugāmena saddhiṃ hasitalapitakīḷitāni anussarati,
an7.50:7.2: api ca kho passati gahapatiṃ vā gahapatiputtaṃ vā pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappitaṃ samaṅgibhūtaṃ paricāriyamānaṃ . . .
an7.50:8.1: na pi passati gahapatiṃ vā gahapatiputtaṃ vā pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappitaṃ samaṅgibhūtaṃ paricāriyamānaṃ,
an7.50:8.2: api ca kho aññataraṃ devanikāyaṃ paṇidhāya brahmacariyaṃ carati ‘imināhaṃ sīlena vā vatena vā tapena vā brahmacariyena vā devo vā bhavissāmi devaññataro vā' ti.
an7.50:8.3: So taṃ assādeti taṃ nikāmeti tena ca vittiṃ āpajjati.
an7.50:8.4: Idam pi kho brāhmaṇa brahmacariyassa khaṇḍam pi chiddam pi sabalam pi kammāsam pi.
an7.50:8.5: Ayaṃ vuccati brāhmaṇa aparisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carati saṃyutto methunena saṃyogena, na parimuccati jātiyā jarāmaraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi, na parimuccati dukkhasmā ti vadāmi.
an7.50:9.1: Yāvakīvañ cāhaṃ brāhmaṇa imesaṃ sattannaṃ methunasaṃyogānaṃ aññataraññataraṃ methunasaṃyogaṃ attani appahīnaṃ samanupassiṃ, neva tāvāhaṃ brāhmaṇa sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddho paccaññāsiṃ,
an7.50:10.1: yato ca kho ahaṃ brāhmaṇa imesaṃ sattannaṃ methunasaṃyogānaṃ aññataraññataraṃ methunasaṃyogaṃ attani appahīnaṃ na samanupassiṃ, athāhaṃ brāhmaṇa sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddho paccaññāsiṃ.
an7.50:10.2: Ñāṇañ ca pana me dassanaṃ udapādi
an7.50:10.3: ‘akuppā me cetovimutti, ayam antimā jāti, natthi dāni punabbhavo' ti.
an7.50:11.1: Evaṃ vutte Jānussoṇī brāhmaṇo Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an7.50:11.3: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ Gotamo dhāretu ajja-t-agge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan'
